title: One-change bargaining arms against the null
source: Engine-arena cohorts on boards 0 to 63, each played once per rotation of four slots: a depth-2 search with one bargaining switch changed, the unchanged default, an ETA builder, and a fast builder. Run IDs are listed in the bargaining arms report.
caption: Each point is the per-seed difference between an arm's contrast and the null cohort's on the same board, with its 95% interval over boards 0 to 63; this removes the slot-order bias but was not preregistered.

y.label: Wins per game, changed seat minus default
